name: Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps
summary: Layout, length, direction, start line and pit side are right. The height profile is badly wrong: the game uses the Copernicus GLO-90 SURFACE model (90 m pixels, trees included) smoothed over ~125 m, which flattens the Eau Rouge / Raidillon climb from 15 % to 3.9 % where it really is, moves the climb 150-900 m up the Kemmel straight (11.6-12.4 % there instead of 4.6 %), and puts a 20-30 m high forest-canopy hump between Paul Frere, Blanchimont and the Bus Stop (invented grades of +11 % / -9 % where the road climbs gently at 1-4 %). This is why the climb "cannot be felt". The Wallonia 0.5 m lidar DTM, run through the build's existing terrain-model pipeline, keeps Raidillon at 14.3-14.5 %. Scenery: a phantom concrete deck floats over the road on the descent to Eau Rouge.

findings.game: Eau Rouge / Raidillon (OSM ways 126835639 + 126835637, 1.0-1.2 km after the game line): 3.9 % over 50 m (4.2 % over 100 m) at the real steepest point; the Raidillon way rises 14.6 m in the game. The game's steepest climbs are instead on the Kemmel straight: 12.4 % (50 m) at 1.93 km and 11.6-11.8 % at 1.18 km, where the real road climbs 4.6 %.
findings.real: Lidar along the OSM centreline: max 15.0 % over 50 m (14.3 % over 100 m, 15.1 % over 10-20 m) at 1.03 km after the line (Raidillon), rising 24.1 m over the 220 m Raidillon way and 24.5 m from the Eau Rouge dip (389.6 m ASL) to the top; the Kemmel straight then climbs a steady 4.3-4.8 % (47.9 m over 1055 m). Published: fr.wikipedia "Raidillon de l'Eau Rouge": "cote tres raide a 17 %" (citing spa-francorchamps.be), "denivele d'environ 40 metres"; en.wikipedia photo caption: "maximum gradient in excess of 18%". (The lidar figure is along the centreline; with the measured 3.3 deg cross slope the fall line is ~16 %, the inside line steeper.)
findings.proposedFix: Switch be-1925 to the Wallonia lidar DTM (new SOURCES entry in tools/build-tracks.mjs, see proposedCorrection.elevationSource) with the existing terrain-model settings (10 m step, 50 m median, 20 m Gauss, 18 % slope limit). Simulated on the lidar (sim.mjs, incl. js/track.js's ~9.8 m height smoothing): Raidillon 14.3 % over 50 m / 14.5 % over 20 m (game now 3.9 %), Kemmel 4.3-4.8 %, rise 24.4 m.

findings.game: Heights from Copernicus GLO-90 (a surface model: forest canopy, grandstands). Relative to the lidar (mean-aligned) the game is up to 29.9 m too HIGH between Paul Frere and the Bus Stop (+25 m at Blanchimont, +29 m 700 m before the line) and 13-15 m too LOW at Raidillon / Kemmel and Malmedy / Bruxelles; RMS error 9.7 m. Invented grades: +9.7 % in Courbe Paul Frere (real 3.2 %), +11.9 % / -7.0 % in Blanchimont (real +1.7..2.9 %), -8.8 % on the run to the Bus Stop (real +3.6 %, i.e. the wrong sign), -10.7 % at Malmedy (real -2.1 %). 25 stretches of >= 30 m differ from the lidar by more than 2 percentage points over 100 m. Cause, checked on the build own cached GLO-90 samples (tools/elevation-cache.json, 271 of 280 keys) against the lidar at the same points: the raw GLO-90 is 11-23 m (max 43.5 m) ABOVE the ground from Paul Frere through Blanchimont to the Bus Stop (wooded: a surface model sees the canopy), +4 m (max +18) around Eau Rouge, and 2-9 m below it on the open Kemmel - Bruxelles slopes (90 m pixels averaging the hillside); the 125 m median + 50 m Gauss then smear what is left.
findings.real: Lidar: 366.6 m ASL at Courbe Paul Frere (Stavelot, the lowest point) to 468.8 m near Malmedy (the highest), range 102.2 m (game 99.0 m); Paul Frere -> Blanchimont -> Bus Stop is a gentle climb (-1.2..+3.8 % over 20 m, +40 m in 1.6 km); the descent Bruxelles -> Pouhon reaches -7.2 % (the game has its steepest 50 m there at -7.4..-9.5 %). Published range: en.wikipedia "102.2 m (335 ft) above the lowest part" (stated in the old-circuit paragraph; the lidar gives the same figure for the current lap).
findings.proposedFix: Same source switch as above. Pipeline simulation on the lidar (sim.mjs): 0.08 m RMS / 0.60 m max from the lidar, range 102.0 m, every section within 0.7 pp of the lidar grades. Alternatively use the 5 m lidar profile in out/profile-be-1925.json directly as a profile override.
sources: SPW "Relief de la Wallonie - Modele Numerique de Terrain (MNT) 2021-2022", 0.5 m lidar DTM, (c) SPW, https://geoservices.wallonie.be/arcgis/rest/services/RELIEF/WALLONIE_MNT_2021_2022/MapServer (identify; catalogue https://geoportail.wallonie.be/catalogue/e257f5df-6c96-4118-b4d2-1e63e955df53.html); samples cached in devtests/track-audit/cache/wallonia-mnt2021/points.json

findings.game: Pit lane on the driver's right (correct), lane from 234 m before to 220 m after the line, entry line 148 m before, exit 134 m after the line (i.e. before La Source), limit 80 km/h. The game's pit lane (js/track.js) is generated beside the start / finish straight from up to 250 m before to 250 m after the line; it cannot follow a real lane that leaves at a chicane or rejoins after the first corner.
findings.real: OSM way 323851541 "Pit Lane" (719 m) leaves the track 375 m before the line, at the exit of the Bus Stop chicane, runs on the right and rejoins 398 m after the line, after La Source on the descent to Eau Rouge. No source found for a limit other than the usual 80 km/h.
findings.proposedFix: None required (generic lane, right side). If the pit model ever supports a longer lane: entry [50.4415508, 5.9667947] (first node of OSM way 323851541, Bus Stop exit), exit [50.4456821, 5.9654089] (its last node, after La Source).

findings.game: Curvature-derived bank up to 5.9 deg: 5.1-5.6 deg through the Bus Stop chicane, 4-4.7 deg at Les Combes / Bruxelles / Campus, ~1 deg in Blanchimont.
findings.real: Lidar cross slope (+-4 m): no corner beyond 4.3 deg; Bus Stop 0.1-1.4 deg, Les Combes 1.9-2.1, Bruxelles 2.5, Blanchimont -3.8 deg (inside-lower camber the game lacks), Raidillon 3.3, La Source 3.7. No real banked corner at Spa (none published).
findings.proposedFix: Optional: bankOverrides from the lidar (proposedCorrection.bankOverridesFromLidar) or a general cap of the derived bank in chicanes; not needed for the "feel" complaint.

findings.game: js/scenery.js builds a concrete bridge deck OVER the road 686 m after the line (on the descent to Eau Rouge), underside 10.6 m above the road (scenery-data.js item kind "bridge" at 50.443965, 5.968340; screenshot devtests/track-audit/be-nl-de-gb/shots/shot-spa-phantom.png). It is a phantom.
findings.real: That item is OSM way 1353164215 (man_made=bridge, layer 1, 97 m2): the outline of the track's OWN short deck over the pedestrian tunnel OSM way 1353164961 (footway, tunnel, layer -1) that passes UNDER the lap there. Nothing crosses over the lap at Spa in OSM (no highway / footway with bridge=yes over it). The lap also passes over the Eau Rouge stream (culverts 77352254 / 175175594) and service roads; the Wallonia DTM keeps the road surface over them (checked: no dip).
findings.proposedFix: Do not build man_made=bridge outlines that carry the lap (outline contains the centreline and a tunnel / layer<0 way or a bridge=yes raceway lies inside it): drop OSM way 1353164215 from scenery-data.js (tools/build-scenery.mjs) or add that test to js/scenery.js addBridge. See proposedCorrection.sceneryBridgesToDrop.
sources: OpenStreetMap (ODbL) via the Overpass API, cached in devtests/track-audit/cache/overpass/be-1925.json; ways 1353164215 (man_made=bridge) and 1353164961 (footway tunnel)
